# uzc_storage_categories (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud storage categories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_storage_categories" "nimbo_tashkent" {
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  region         = "tashkent"
}

output "storage_category_slugs" {
  value = [for c in data.uzc_storage_categories.nimbo_tashkent.storage_categories : c.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `cloud_provider_setup` (String)
- `region` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `storage_categories` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_categories))
